name: Webhook Map
purpose: Map all webhook endpoints to ensure proper boundary enforcement

webhooks.purpose: Payment status updates and refund processing
signature_validation: Compares computed signature with provided signature
payload_validation: Event type validation: payment.captured, payment.failed, refund.processed, etc.
idempotency: razorpay_payment_id in payload used as deduplication key
Checks if payment already processed before updating status
Idempotency header sent back to Razorpay in response
transaction: Database transaction for payment status update
Includes related operations: booking status update, settlement eligibility check
event_persistence: Raw webhook payload stored in razorpay_webhooks table for audit
Processed events marked as processed to prevent re-processing
processing: Trigger related business processes (settlement eligibility, booking confirmation)
retry_behavior: Razorpay retries failed webhooks (non-2xx responses) for up to 24 hours
response_code: 400: Bad Request - Razorpay stops retrying (client error)
500: Internal Server Error - Razorpay will retry (server error)
security_considerations: Signature validation is critical to prevent spoofing
HTTPS enforced for all webhook endpoints
IP whitelisting recommended but not currently implemented
Payload size limits to prevent DoS

idempotency: razorpay_refund_id in payload used as deduplication key
Checks if refund already processed before updating status
transaction: Database transaction for refund status update
Includes related operations: payment status update, fee adjustments
event_persistence: Raw webhook payload stored in razorpay_webhooks table
processing: Update related payment status if full refund
retry_behavior: Same as payment webhook - Razorpay retries for up to 24 hours

webhooks.purpose: OAuth callback and token refresh notifications
signature_validation: CSRF protection via state parameter matching
payload_validation: Validation of authorization code or tokens in query parameters
Checks for error parameters in response
idempotency: OAuth authorization codes are single-use by design
Access token refreshes may require additional deduplication
transaction: Database transaction for user account creation/update
event_persistence: OAuth tokens stored in database with expiration tracking
processing: Fetch user info from Google API
Redirect to frontend or return JSON response
retry_behavior: Not applicable - OAuth flow is user-initiated
User must restart flow if failed

summary.boundary_compliance: To be verified - need to check that controllers delegate to application handlers and not process logic directly
recommendations: Ensure webhook controllers delegate to application use cases rather than processing logic directly
Verify that signature validation occurs before any payload processing
Check that idempotency is properly implemented for all webhook types
Confirm that webhook processing is wrapped in appropriate transactions
Validate that webhook event persistence occurs before business processing
Ensure retry behavior aligns with provider specifications
